component.name: alibaba-fc
component.title: Alibaba Function Compute (FC)
component.description: Invoke serverless functions on Alibaba Cloud Function Compute (FC).
component.label: cloud,serverless

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

CamelAlibabaFcServiceName.label: producer
CamelAlibabaFcServiceName.description: The name of the service that contains the function. This header replaces the serviceName option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the serviceName option.

CamelAlibabaFcFunctionName.label: producer
CamelAlibabaFcFunctionName.description: The name of the function. This header replaces the functionName option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the functionName option.

CamelAlibabaFcQualifier.label: producer
CamelAlibabaFcQualifier.description: The version or alias of the service. This header replaces the qualifier option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the qualifier option.

CamelAlibabaFcRequestId.label: producer
CamelAlibabaFcRequestId.description: The request ID that Function Compute returns in the response to invokeFunction. The producer sets it for invokeFunction, unless the exchange fails.

CamelAlibabaFcStatusCode.label: producer
CamelAlibabaFcStatusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the response to the operation. The producer sets it, unless the exchange fails.

producerIn.description: invokeFunction sends the body as the payload of the function: text in UTF-8, bytes as they are, a stream or a file as its bytes, so binary data is kept, and no body as an empty payload. A Map or a POJO fails, as it does not convert to bytes, so marshal it first. getFunction does not use the body

producerOut.description: A Map: for invokeFunction the statusCode, the headers and the body of the response, which holds the payload the function returns as bytes, with the status code in the CamelAlibabaFcStatusCode header too; for getFunction the fields of the function, such as functionName, runtime and handler

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAlibabaFcOperation header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option.

endpoint.description: The endpoint of Function Compute, which is a host name without http:// or https://. The producer sends requests to it over HTTPS. If not set, the region option determines the endpoint, and one of the two is required. Not used when the fcClient option is set or autowired.

functionName.description: The name of the function. The CamelAlibabaFcFunctionName header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. One of the three is required.

qualifier.description: The version or alias of the service. The CamelAlibabaFcQualifier header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer adds no version or alias to the request.

region.description: The region ID of Function Compute, for example cn-hangzhou. Only used when the endpoint option is not set, to build the endpoint of Function Compute. Not used when the fcClient option is set or autowired.

serviceName.description: The name of the service that contains the function. The CamelAlibabaFcServiceName header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. One of the three is required.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

fcClient.label: advanced
fcClient.description: To use a custom com.aliyun.fc_open20210406.Client. The producer sends its requests with this client, and the region, endpoint, accessKey, secretKey and serviceKeys options are not used. If no client is set or autowired, the Camel endpoint creates a client from these options. It creates this client when the producer processes its first message.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The AccessKey ID of the AccessKey pair for the requests that the producer sends to Function Compute. If not set, the accessKey of the serviceKeys option is used, and one of the two is required. Not used when the fcClient option is set or autowired.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The AccessKey secret of the AccessKey pair for the requests that the producer sends to Function Compute. If not set, the secretKey of the serviceKeys option is used, and one of the two is required. Not used when the fcClient option is set or autowired.

serviceKeys.label: security
serviceKeys.description: The AccessKey pair as an org.apache.camel.component.alibaba.common.models.ServiceKeys. Its accessKey is the AccessKey ID and its secretKey is the AccessKey secret. Each of the two is used when the option of the same name is not set. Not used when the fcClient option is set or autowired.
